data.headline: Asbury Park entitlement activity meets STHO’s stated development-site monetization strategy

claims.text: Asbury Park City Council’s September 23, 2026 agenda listed 6 entitlement items involving Block 3801 and 320 Asbury Avenue.

citation.quote: Block 3801, Lot 1.021 (F/K/A Block 3801, a Portion Of Lot 1.02) 320 Asbury Avenue On The City

claims.text: Asbury Park City Council’s September 9, 2026 agenda listed 7 items involving Block 3801, 320 Asbury Avenue and the Waterfront Redevelopment Area.

citation.quote: 320 Asbury Avenue On The City Tax Map within the Asbury Park Waterfront Redevelopment Area And Granting A Tax Exemption

claims.text: Asbury Park City Council’s October 14, 2026 agenda listed 1 item concerning the Waterfront Redevelopment Plan and a portion of St. James Place.

citation.quote: Place Pursuant To N.J.S.A. 40:67-1, Et Seq. And The City’s Waterfront Redevelopment Plan

claims.text: Asbury Park’s September 28, 2026 Planning Board agenda listed 1 item for The Views at Westley Lake, a preliminary and final major site plan in the Waterfront Redevelopment Area.

citation.quote: The Views at Westley Lake / 216 Cookman Avenue / Block 3802, Lot 1 / APW Redeveloper, LLC / Preliminary & Final Major Site Plan / Waterfront Redevelopment Area / Prime Renewal Area

claims.text: STHO, through Asbury Partners, LLC, is the managing member of the joint venture owning the Asbury Park Waterfront investment, whose carrying value was approximately $120.9 million as of June 30, 2026.

citation.quote: We are the managing member in Asbury Partners, LLC, which is the joint venture that owns the Asbury Park Waterfront investment. The aggregate carrying value of the Asbury Park Waterfront investment was approximately $120.9 million as of June 30, 2026.

claims.text: STHO’s current Asbury Park strategy is to asset-manage operating assets and monetize remaining development sites and operating assets through sales to third-party developers and operators while meeting its redevelopment-agreement obligations.

citation.quote: Our current strategy for the Asbury Park Waterfront investment is to actively asset manage our operating assets, and strategically monetize the remaining development sites and our operating assets through sales to third party developers and operators while meeting our obligations under the redevelopment agreement with the city of Asbury Park.
